title: Billed Hours Utilization Outstanding Balance by Client
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=freelance:hours
| where billing_status!="invoiced"
| stats sum(hours_billed) as outstanding_amount count as open_records by client
| sort - outstanding_amount
description: Ranks open billed hours utilization balances so you can see where the most money is still not settled.
value: Outstanding-balance ranking focuses your follow-up time where it matters most instead of on whatever record you looked at last.
implementation: Normalize `billing_status` so only genuinely unresolved records remain in the outstanding queue.
visualization: Bar chart of outstanding amount by client.
grandmaExplanation: It compares who still owes money or has unresolved financial work in billed hours utilization.
